open_points.subject: paged record filtering for the repair view
open_points.text: “store.page_records pages one record type in reverse store order under a filter the caller gives — a field equal to a value or in a set of values” contradicts “for a listed record type, its rows in store order, all of them or those whose column for one filter field equals a value — and nothing else.”
open_points.question: How can the State 4 repair view page NodeExecutions whose executed implementation is in a set when StoreRepository offers only a single equality filter?
options: Allow a typed set-membership filter in StoreRepository
Have store merge multiple equality queries into one correctly ordered page and continuation stream
Remove set filtering and change the repair-view flow
open_points.default_guess: Allow a typed set-membership filter in StoreRepository.
